author: Good Work
description:
Sponsored by Zocdoc. Spend less time searching and more time with the people who matter most. Head to https://zocdoc.com/goodwork to find and book the care you need #sponsor

We used to be a proper country with proper lunches. Now we order wittle weenie bowls off ipad. What happened to our beautiful midday business meal?

Featuring:

Laura Shapiro, food journalist and historian (https://laurashapirowriter.com/)

Megan Elias, Food and Wine Curator at the Smithsonian’s Museum of American History (https://meganjelias.com/)

Gary Egan, General Manager and Archivist at Pete’s Tavern (GO TO PETE’S!)

Nick Vaccaro, lovely young man and host of the brand new three martini lunch account on ig (FOLLOW @threemartinilunch)

Greg Adams, CFO / CPA / author of one of our favorite books, Green $hades (BUY IT https://www.cpa-author.com/)

Special thanks to Pete’s Tavern and Vinile Chophouse. Go enjoy yourself at these establishments!

Created by Jack Stebbins, Henry Stockwell, and Dan Toomey
